notes.title: Hotfix - June 14, 2025
notes.content: [p]Since the start of Next Fest, we’ve received a lot of enthusiastic feedback from players, and we’re truly grateful. All feedback has been documented, but due to recent busy travels, we haven’t had time to respond—please forgive us for that.[/p][p]The current version update includes several major changes, such as:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Simplified Chinese players were incorrectly identified as Traditional Chinese upon launch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a soft-lock issue in Chapter 1 and errors in triggering certain dialogues.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected typos and mistranslations in the prologue’s localization.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted visual effects to reduce flickering issues.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you encounter any problems during gameplay, you can email us at long.knives.info@gmail.com with details about your problems. We will reach out to you soon.[/p][p]Thank you for believing in us.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Next Fest & Localization
notes.content:
[i][b]Long Knives[/b][/i] will appear in the Steam Next Fest in June.

We have released the polished Chapter 1, which is:
[list]
[*] Not with a new plot/mechanic at all
[*] Edited for better reading
[*] Upgraded with visual assets
[*] Offering support in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean
[/list]
Chapter 2 is done by now, but we are still testing it. The full version with Chapters 1 & 2 will be released before the Next Fest begins. The play time for Chapter is expected to be approximately 2 times longer than that of Chapter 1.

Thank you for your support.
